faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What do luxury home interior designs in Hauz Khas look like?

Calm, well-proportioned rooms with natural stone, fine wood, custom furniture and layered lighting. The aim is a home that feels rich but relaxed, not over-decorated.

Do you source imported materials and furniture?

Yes. We can source imported stone, fabrics, fittings and furniture, and we also work with skilled local craftsmen for custom pieces.

Can art and collections be built into the design?

Yes. We plan display walls, lighting and niches for art and collectibles, so they become part of the home rather than an afterthought.

How do luxury home interior designs stay practical?

Hidden storage, durable finishes and easy maintenance are planned from the start, so the home stays beautiful in daily family life.
